assurance_rule: The structural contract is assurance-neutral. Included visitor content must bind to selected accepted ProductFactsV2 facts, a configured standard, or checksum-bound README-inherited evidence. README-inherited evidence is not promoted to repository-verified assurance.

opening_slots.rule: Exactly one complete visitor-facing product identity; API, package, namespace, command, and import shorthand remain technical-context-only.
Exactly one row containing only applicable fact-bound badges.
Repository-specific product value and audience summary; no commercial link block above the fold.

section_slots.rule: List every included H2 exactly once using its GitHub anchor.
Detailed, non-directional input/capability/output Mermaid using the complete product name.
Include only verified examples; collapse long inventories in standard and extended profiles.
Include only repository-verified public API; collapse long inventories in standard and extended profiles.
State constraints directly; contextual Enterprise Edition links may occur only when selected and budgeted.
Preserve verified maintainer commands and workflows; long extended content may collapse.
Use its own heading and a repository-relative notice-file link only when the file is verified.
Readable prose links the license and explains practical permissions.

global_invariants: No HTML comments, code comments, emojis, default copyright line, or cross-product Aspose FOSS identity.
Every optional section receives an explicit include or omission disposition in ProductFactsV2 mode.
Commercial Aspose products are called Enterprise Edition.
No Note-specific prose is a template default.
